topic.label: Math
topic.desc: Mathematics as working skills: algebra, calculus and differential equations, linear algebra, probability and statistics, discrete mathematics, proof and foundations, numerical methods and optimisation, and geometry and topology.

concepts.label: Algebra
concepts.desc: Solving and simplifying equations and inequalities, polynomials, functions, exponentials and logarithms, and abstract structures such as groups and rings.

concepts.label: Calculus and Differential Equations
concepts.desc: Limits, derivatives, integrals, series and ordinary and partial differential equations, with their physical meaning.

concepts.label: Discrete Mathematics and Combinatorics
concepts.desc: Counting, graphs, number theory, recurrences and algorithms on finite structures.

concepts.label: Geometry and Topology
concepts.desc: Shapes, transformations, coordinates, curves and surfaces, and properties that survive stretching.

concepts.label: Linear Algebra
concepts.desc: Vectors, matrices, linear systems, eigenvalues, decompositions and vector spaces.

concepts.label: Numerical Methods and Optimisation
concepts.desc: Computing answers approximately and checking the error: root finding, integration, linear solvers, floating point and optimisation.

concepts.label: Probability and Statistics
concepts.desc: Random variables, distributions, estimation, hypothesis tests, regression and the limits of what a sample shows.

concepts.label: Proof and Foundations
concepts.desc: Logic, sets, proof techniques such as induction and contradiction, and how to read and write a rigorous argument.

skills.label: Abstract Algebra Explainer
skills.desc: Explains groups, rings and fields with small worked examples and checks that a given set meets the axioms.

skills.label: Equation and Inequality Solver
skills.desc: Solves equations and inequalities step by step, checks each solution by substitution and lists any that were introduced by the method.

skills.label: Polynomial and Function Analyzer
skills.desc: Factors polynomials, finds roots, asymptotes and symmetries and sketches the function from them.

skills.label: Differentiation and Integration Assistant
skills.desc: Differentiates and integrates a function by named rules, shows each step and verifies the result by differentiating back.

skills.label: Differential Equation Solver
skills.desc: Solves ordinary and simple partial differential equations analytically or numerically and states the initial and boundary conditions used.

skills.label: Limits and Series Analyst
skills.desc: Evaluates limits and decides whether a series converges, naming the test used and why it applies.

skills.label: Counting and Combinatorics Solver
skills.desc: Counts arrangements and selections with permutations, combinations and inclusion and exclusion and checks small cases by listing.

skills.label: Graph Theory Analyst
skills.desc: Analyses paths, connectivity, colouring and flows on a graph and states the algorithm and its running time.

skills.label: Number Theory Helper
skills.desc: Works with primes, divisibility, modular arithmetic and congruences, with a worked check for each result.

skills.label: Coordinate and Transformation Helper
skills.desc: Converts between coordinate systems and applies rotations, scalings and translations with matrices.

skills.label: Curve and Surface Analyst
skills.desc: Computes length, area, curvature and tangents of curves and surfaces from a parametrisation.

skills.label: Topology Explainer
skills.desc: Explains open sets, continuity, connectedness and homeomorphism with simple spaces and checks which properties are preserved.

skills.label: Eigenvalue and Decomposition Analyst
skills.desc: Computes eigenvalues, eigenvectors and decompositions such as SVD and explains what they say about the matrix.

skills.label: Linear System Solver
skills.desc: Solves linear systems by elimination, reports whether the solution is unique, absent or free, and checks the residual.

skills.label: Vector Space Explainer
skills.desc: Explains basis, span, rank and projection with small examples in two and three dimensions.

skills.label: Floating Point Auditor
skills.desc: Finds rounding, cancellation and overflow problems in a computation and proposes a stabler form.

skills.label: Optimization Planner
skills.desc: Sets up an optimisation problem with objective, variables and constraints, picks a method and checks the result is a true optimum.

skills.label: Root Finding and Numerical Integration
skills.desc: Applies bisection, Newton or quadrature rules and reports the error estimate and the iteration count.

skills.label: Distribution Fitter
skills.desc: Fits candidate distributions to data, compares them with goodness of fit and states which assumptions each requires.

skills.label: Hypothesis Test Selector
skills.desc: Chooses a test such as ANOVA, a chi-square test or a nonparametric test from the data type and design, runs it, and reports effect size and interval along with the p-value.

skills.label: Regression Analyst
skills.desc: Fits linear and generalised regression models, checks residuals and warns when the fit is driven by a few points.

skills.label: Counterexample Finder
skills.desc: Searches for small cases that break a conjecture or lemma and reports what the failure says about the claim.

skills.label: Proof Checker
skills.desc: Reads a proof line by line, marks gaps and unjustified steps and says whether the argument proves the stated claim.

skills.label: Proof Writer
skills.desc: Writes a proof by induction, contradiction or construction, with every step justified and the claim restated at the end.
